response.sql: SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS num_transactions FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY num_transactions DESC, account_id ASC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Transactions of every type (PRIJEM, VYDAJ, and the undocumented VYBER rows) are included, since the request does not filter by type. The average is over the unsigned amount column, as the verified notes say amount is stored unsigned.
Ties in transaction count are broken by account_id ascending so the top 10 is deterministic. The request does not specify a tie-break.
